description: Edit Markdown files in a what-you-see-is-what-you-get editor, powered by Milkdown.
command.openEditorToSide: Open WYSIWYG Editor to the Side
config.imageFolder: Folder, relative to the Markdown file, where pasted or dropped images are saved. Leave empty to save next to the file.
config.maxWidth: Maximum width of the editing area in pixels. `0` uses the full width.
config.tableOfContents: Show a table of contents at the right edge of the editor. Hover it to list the headings, and click one to jump to it.
